multi_niche_rule: Stored ONCE under primary niche (highest relevance_by_niche); secondary niches hold a cross-reference pointer (corpus_record_id), NOT a copy. Ambiguous (top-3 disagree, confidence<0.8) -> human gate, never silent placement.
entity_rule: Every gene_symbol binds to analysis/outputs/verified_identifiers.json via resolve(). hit -> use ENSDARG + tier; positive NOT_FOUND -> keep with confidence 0 + gap_flag; absent from store -> QUARANTINE (UNVERIFIED) until Ensembl lookup + raw-cache (§7.9) + human-gated store update. NEVER mint an ID from memory.
